summary: Implementation plan for 'রাত ৩টার ডেলিভারি (3 AM Delivery)' - a full production-grade 3D Bengali psychological horror delivery game featuring a real-time WebGL/Three.js engine directly playable in browser and mobile touch screens, authentic Bengali spatial Web Audio soundscape, 10 unique lore-based missions, 3 intelligent ghost entities with custom AI behaviors, and complete Godot 4 source project files with Android/Web export templates.
